title: USCG navigation area check
description: Exactly one dataset item per run: official USCG NAVCEN MSI records intersecting the queried point, route or bbox, with per-dataset coverage. Zero matches means no matching records were found in the official datasets successfully checked. It is not a statement that navigation is hazard-free or unrestricted. Not navigational advice.

result.title: Navigation area check record
result.description: The single record: status, query, coverage (categoriesChecked, completeForRequestedLayers, sourceFailures), summary counts and notices with official text, validity, geometry and relationshipToQuery.
